hints.text: To maximize subsequence size under a sum cap, greedily pick the smallest available numbers.

hints.title: Sorted Cumulative Sums
hints.text: Sort the array and compute the prefix sums of the sorted elements.

hints.title: Query Bisection
hints.text: For each query target, find the upper bound index in the prefix sums list using binary search.

hints.title: Sorted Prefix Search Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def answerQueries(self, nums: list[int], queries: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        nums.sort()
        pref = []
        cur = 0
        for x in nums:
            cur += x
            pref.append(cur)
        return [bisect.bisect_right(pref, q) for q in queries]
```

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); each of m queries runs bisect_right in O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning nums repeatedly for each query results in O(n * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sum array provides monotonic values for fast binary queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts nums greedily and performs binary search over prefix sums.
